title: "Session Presentation Timers"
author: "University of Maryland"
format:
  revealjs:
    theme: default
    slide-number: true
    center: true
---
```{=html}
<style>
  /* Traffic Light and Timer Layout Styles */
  .timer-container {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    gap: 3rem;
    margin-top: 2rem;
  }

  .timer-text {
    font-size: 6rem;
    font-weight: bold;
    letter-spacing: 2px;
  }
  
  .timer-display {
    font-family: monospace;
    font-size: 7rem;
    font-weight: bold;
    letter-spacing: 2px;
  }
  
  /* Traffic Light Box */
  .traffic-light {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    background: #222;
    padding: 15px;
    border-radius: 20px;
    gap: 12px;
    box-shadow: 0 10px 25px rgba(0,0,0,0.4);
  }
  
  .light {
    width: 125px;
    height: 125px;
    border-radius: 50%;
    border: 3px solid #444;
    background-color: transparent;
    transition: background-color 0.3s ease, box-shadow 0.3s ease;
  }
  
  /* State Colors (Hollow by default, filled when active) */
  .light.red { border-color: #ff4d4d; }
  .light.red.active { background-color: #ff4d4d; box-shadow: 0 0 20px #ff4d4d; }
  
  .light.amber { border-color: #ffc107; }
  .light.amber.active { background-color: #ffc107; box-shadow: 0 0 20px #ffc107; }
  
  .light.green { border-color: #28a745; }
  .light.green.active { background-color: #28a745; box-shadow: 0 0 20px #28a745; }
</style>
```        

# Example Session
::: {.timer-container data-duration="20" data-warning="5" data-hold="5" data-start-audio="/assets/audio/time-start.mp3" data-end-audio="/assets/audio/times-up.mp3"}

```{=html}
<div class="timer-display">05:00</div>
<div class="traffic-light">
  <div class="light red"></div>
  <div class="light amber"></div>
  <div class="light green"></div>
</div>
```

:::

## Session 2
::: {.timer-container data-duration="20" data-warning="5" data-hold="0" data-start-audio="" data-end-audio=""}

```{=html}
<div class="timer-display">05:00</div>
<div class="traffic-light">
  <div class="light red"></div>
  <div class="light amber"></div>
  <div class="light green"></div>
</div>
```

:::


```{=html}
<script>
document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", () => {
  let timerInterval = null;

  function initTimer() {
    // Clear any previous interval
    if (timerInterval) {
      clearInterval(timerInterval);
      timerInterval = null;
    }

    if (typeof Reveal === 'undefined') return;
    const currentSlide = Reveal.getCurrentSlide();
    if (!currentSlide) return;

    const timerWrapper = currentSlide.querySelector('.timer-container');
    if (!timerWrapper || !timerWrapper.hasAttribute('data-duration')) return;

    const totalDuration = parseInt(timerWrapper.getAttribute('data-duration')) || 300;
    const warningTime = parseInt(timerWrapper.getAttribute('data-warning')) || 60;
    const holdTime = parseInt(timerWrapper.getAttribute('data-hold')) || 3;
    const startAudioSrc = timerWrapper.getAttribute('data-start-audio');
    const endAudioSrc = timerWrapper.getAttribute('data-end-audio');

    const display = timerWrapper.querySelector('.timer-display');
    const redLight = timerWrapper.querySelector('.light.red');
    const amberLight = timerWrapper.querySelector('.light.amber');
    const greenLight = timerWrapper.querySelector('.light.green');

    let timeLeft = totalDuration;

    function formatTime(secs) {
      const m = Math.floor(secs / 60).toString().padStart(2, '0');
      const s = (secs % 60).toString().padStart(2, '0');
      return `${m}:${s}`;
    }

    function setLights(color) {
      if (!redLight || !amberLight || !greenLight) return;
      redLight.classList.toggle('active', color === 'red');
      amberLight.classList.toggle('active', color === 'amber');
      greenLight.classList.toggle('active', color === 'green');
    }

    function playSound(src) {
      if (src && src.trim() !== "") {
        const audio = new Audio(src);
        audio.play().catch(e => console.log("Audio blocked:", e));
      }
    }

    // Initial state setup
    if (display) display.textContent = formatTime(timeLeft);
    setLights('green');
    playSound(startAudioSrc);

    // Start the countdown loop explicitly
    timerInterval = setInterval(() => {
      timeLeft--;

      if (timeLeft > warningTime) {
        setLights('green');
      } else if (timeLeft > 0) {
        setLights('amber');
      } else {
        timeLeft = 0;
        setLights('red');
        if (display) display.textContent = formatTime(0);
        clearInterval(timerInterval);
        timerInterval = null;

        playSound(endAudioSrc);

        setTimeout(() => {
          if (typeof Reveal !== 'undefined' && Reveal.getCurrentSlide() === currentSlide) {
            Reveal.next();
          }
        }, holdTime * 1000);
      }

      if (display && timeLeft > 0) {
        display.textContent = formatTime(timeLeft);
      }
    }, 1000);
  }

  // Hook into Reveal lifecycle events safely
  setTimeout(() => {
    if (typeof Reveal !== 'undefined') {
      initTimer();
      Reveal.on('slidechanged', () => initTimer());
      Reveal.on('ready', () => initTimer());
    }
  }, 300);
});
</script>
```
